Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1468
Claimant:
Carol Smith
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
2024-05-04
Claim opened after a side impact at an intersection, with the insured vehicle struck on the driver's side. The insured
reported a neck strain and advised that the claimant is now represented by counsel, so all contact will go through the
attorney's office.
2024-06-08
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is named on it and the coverage was active at the time of loss. Nothing
in the file suggests the vehicle damage predates the policy start.
2024-06-21
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the collision. Two independent
witnesses gave statements describing the same sequence of events.
2024-08-08
Reviewed scene photographs and the other driver's statement, both of which match the described impact. The
damage pattern on the vehicle is consistent with a side impact at the angle reported.
2024-08-09
Took a recorded statement from the claimant through counsel. The account matched what was given at the scene
and in the initial report, with no changes in the details.
2024-08-25
Received the medical records and bills from the treating provider. The reported neck strain is a plausible injury for a
collision of this type, and no earlier injury to that body area appears in the prior records.
2024-09-05
Inspected the vehicle and noted a few old scratches near the damaged panel. These may be older than this collision,
so the repair estimate has been set aside for a closer look at those areas.
2024-09-13
Treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, and the treating notes expalin the reasons for the
extended care. Requested a peer review of the treatment timeline to confirm the length of care is reasonable.
2024-10-09
Peer review is pending, and the file is being kept open while counsel provides the requested updates. Reserves
remain in place until the review and the repair estimate are finalized.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
